model.name: merge.saveWriteBounded
model.description: The server writes the merged Save into the file within the RepoRegistry-resolved repo root (bounded by sanitizePath), so a diff/merge Save targets the correct repo/branch and cannot escape the root - no 404, no path traversal. Server WRITE-half of merge.saveToCurrentBranch (bcc27da9=client POST). Minted 2026-07-19 (architect backstop) to give FileApi.writeFile its own R30.38 chain hop, distinct from the R30.6.7 read-path (RepoRegistry.resolve d7dc0059).
